title: Protocol Implementation eXtra Information for Testing

test_suite.expectation_model: each case declares `expected` (the check ids that must fire) and `refused`

excluded_from_this_run: checks that require the teleinfo production domain (s01/s04/s06 of the bench, not of the verifier)
network-dependent DID resolution (did:web) - all runs were offline
registry-backed states (independent / superseded) - the registry holds one entry
the corpus's W3C report emission/ingestion paths (--emit-w3c-report / --read-w3c-report) were not exercised

clock.consequence: two runs cannot be compared across time; a replay comparison must be same-day by construction

known_limits: Windows filesystem case-insensitivity may mask a duplicate-member attack that POSIX would catch
the verifier reads the seal key out of the package in open mode, so a PASS proves internal consistency, not external trust

own_corpus.note: home-made; the 36 cases are not the third-party suite
